confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are medium confidence. They are based on aggregated 2026 sources (Numbeo-derived figures via Expatica, Expatistan, MyLifeElsewhere, Gotripzi, Freenance) that disagree by roughly 10-30%. Euro figures were converted with an assumed EUR/USD of about 1.15, which I did not search for, so all USD values carry some FX uncertainty. Cocktail is low confidence: the only figure found (about EUR 10, Expatistan) is flagged by its source as unreliable, so I cross-checked it against the beer anchor using a typical cocktail-to-beer ratio of about 2.5 to 3. Wine glass is low to medium confidence, since no firm general glass-of-wine price was found; the estimate follows local txakoli and bar wine reports of EUR 3 to 5. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Bilbao's hotel and hostel market. No accommodation searches were run and no live listings were inspected. Dorm and private hostel values reflect typical registered hostel rates in a mid-sized Spanish city; the 1-star and 3-star values reflect typical basic guesthouse and mid-range hotel rates. Accommodation confidence is low.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a mid-sized northern Spanish city with a strong tourist economy. Food and drink benchmarked against Basque and Spanish city cost-of-living sources (Bilbao-specific figures, with San Sebastian treated as a higher-priced comparable). Accommodation is a holistic estimate against comparable Spanish mid-sized tourist cities; no direct local listing data was used.
